description:
Test an integration

Calls the connected service with the stored credentials and reports what came back. Use it after creating or reconfiguring an integration, since nothing is verified at write time. The shape of the result depends on the integration type: each connector builds its own diagnostic payload, so read it as free-form JSON rather than a fixed schema, and expect at least an indication of success and a message when it failed. Anything resembling a credential is stripped from the result before it is returned. A connection that fails is still reported inside a 200 response, not as an HTTP error. For Genesys Cloud the result has a fixed shape. Without generated access data the test fails and carries no `data`.

id.description: Identifier of the integration to test.
